summary: I tested the browser-side PDF tools end to end on the preview URL using real fixture files. I checked every downloaded output with pypdf. All 7 tools work: Merge (order follows move-up/down: C,B,A), Compress (low/medium/high on a 7.3 MB file gave 7.29 MB, 785 KB and 272 KB, same page count; on a small PDF the original is returned unchanged and result-note is shown), Split (all -> 3 PDFs; '1-2,3' -> 2 PDFs), Remove Pages, Organize ('3,1,2'), JPG to PDF (JPG/PNG mix in order; 20 images -> 20 pages) and Rotate (90 on all pages). All limit messages match the required text exactly: empty, >10 MB, unsupported .docx/.txt, 21 images, fake PDF and encrypted PDF. '20 of 20 images selected' is shown, and removing a file then adding another works. Header, homepage section order, footer links, 404 for /pdf-to-word, refresh on deep links, the mobile menu and no horizontal overflow at 390/768 px all pass. The production build prints 'Prerendered 24 pages + sitemap.xml'. All 24 HTML pages have a unique title, one meta description, one canonical, og:image, valid JSON-LD and crawlable h1 text and links. The sitemap lists 24 URLs with no admin URLs, robots.txt is correct and all favicon/icon files exist (og-image is 1200x630). A static serve of the build works with all /api calls blocked (tested compress medium and merge). Backend: /api/stats and admin login/overview pass (7/7). Issues: every public page logs a 401 console error, mouse-clicking 'All Tools' closes the menu, and unknown URLs are a soft 404.

minor.issue: User input errors ('abc' pages, wrong file type, encrypted PDF) are recorded as failed jobs, which makes the admin failure stats look worse than they are.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'All Tools' with a mouse closes the menu. Hovering already opens it (onMouseEnter), so the click then toggles it shut and aria-expanded ends up false. Enter and Escape on the keyboard work.

Every public page calls GET /api/auth/me, which returns 401 and logs 'Failed to load resource: 401' in the console. This breaks the 'no console errors on main routes' requirement. Only call /auth/me on /admin routes.

issues: Step 2 says 'Drag the image cards' but reordering only uses up/down arrows. Step 3 says 'Click Convert to PDF' but the button is labelled 'JPG to PDF'.
The 'Helpful guides' section is missing; the other 6 tool pages have it.
Shows a raw 'pdf-to-word' row because the hidden tool has no label.

action_items: Fix the ToolsDropdown hover+click conflict: make onClick open the menu when hover already opened it, or drop the hover-open behaviour.
Stop calling /api/auth/me outside /admin routes so public pages have no console errors.

Soft 404: firebase.json rewrites '**' to /app.html, which has robots 'index, follow' and no canonical. Unknown URLs return HTTP 200. Add noindex to app.html (or prerender a 404.html and only rewrite /admin/**).

The production bundle has REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL baked in as the preview URL. On Firebase, /api/stats, /api/config/public and the admin pages would hit the preview backend cross-origin. Set the production backend URL (or remove these calls) before deploying.
Fix the jpg-to-pdf how-to wording and add helpful guides to /rotate-pdf.
critical_code_review_comments: ToolRunner.addFiles reads the stale 'files' closure instead of a functional setState. This is fine for one input at a time, but quick repeated drops could lose files.
When a selection has both an unsupported file and too many images, only the last error is shown.
Organize accepts duplicate or missing pages (e.g. '1,1'), which silently drops or duplicates pages. Consider warning the user.
/api/config/public is fetched twice per page load.
seed_data_creation: No DB seed data. Fixtures are generated into /tmp/fx by /app/tests/make_fixtures.py. Tests added a few /api/stats counter increments.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'python3 /app/tests/make_fixtures.py' to create the fixtures, then run the Playwright flows (downloads saved to /tmp/dl) and 'python3 /app/tests/verify_downloads.py'. Run seo_build_audit.py after 'CI=false yarn build'. Header nav testids are nav-merge, nav-compress, nav-split, nav-jpg-to-pdf and nav-blog (not nav-merge-pdf). The admin stats endpoint is /api/admin/overview.
